$comment: What the rewrite has taken from upstream, one entry per upstream commit after `base`, oldest first. The source of truth; docs/upstream-sync.md is rendered from it. Maintained with scripts/upstream_sync.py; the procedure is docs/upstream-sync-procedure.md.

entries.subject: feat(player): add keyboard shortcuts for subtitle offset
entries.notes: Same keys, step and panel flash as upstream. Differences: the two-second hide timer belongs to the player lifetime, so leaving the player hides the panel and drops the timer (upstream leaves a bare setTimeout); a new test pins the admin shortcut grid to the server defaults.

entries.subject: v12.15.0.0
entries.notes: AssemblyVersion and FileVersion 12.15.0.0, as upstream main. docs/advanced/api.md names the same version.

entries.subject: v12.15.0.0 - Jellyfin Enhanced (synced from jellyfin-plugins)
entries.notes: manifest.json is byte-identical to upstream’s at c22870b2. That includes the catalog entry for the Jellyfin 10.11 build of 12.15.0.0: it is release data about an artifact upstream published, not 10.11 code, and the catalog serves 10.11 servers from the same file. The rewrite builds for Jellyfin 12 only; nothing is built or published by this commit.

entries.subject: fix(status-tags): only show New Episode on recent air date, not on recent add
entries.notes: Same rule change on the web (statustags.ts) and native (StatusRules.cs) side. Added native tests (upstream changed the native rule without one) and corrected the New Episode row of docs/enhanced/tags.md, which upstream left saying "aired or was added" (filed as a found bug). The rule change alters the tags produced for the same data, so PosterTagSettings.ResolverVersion goes from 39 to 40 here (AGENTS.md, "Cached output"); upstream left it at 39 (filed as a found bug).

entries.subject: test(status-tags): update New Episode badge test for air-date-only rule
entries.notes: The same test row change, in tests/frontend/features/media-tags/.

entries.subject: fix(tags): redraw changed cards and keep collection language flags current (#1029)
entries.notes: Client: the same redraw of changed cards, in the rewrite’s pipeline modules (scan.ts, delta-sync.ts, queue.ts). Server: the same collection-member tracking, but TagCacheService.cs is capped and may not grow, so the index, its rules and GetCollectionLanguages live in the new partial TagCacheCollectionMembers.cs and the service keeps one-line call sites (4,124 to 4,088 lines; the allow-list entry is lowered to match). Upstream’s 11 node tests, 6 browser tests and 22 backend tests are translated unchanged in substance.

entries.subject: fix(toast): let a duration of 0 turn toasts off and make the preview match
entries.notes: Same rule in the three places the rewrite reads the setting (features/settings/state.ts, core/ui/runtime.ts through host/ui-host.ts, admin/config/page/timing.ts). Difference: a toast shown before the configuration exists still gets 1500 ms; upstream would schedule it with an undefined duration when JE.CONFIG lacks the value.

entries.subject: test(parity): update New Episode status fixture for the air-date-only rule
entries.notes: The same fixture change; the offline parity run passes with 241 Status fixtures and 0 web/native differences.

entries.subject: chore(ci)(deps): bump the github-actions group with 6 updates (#1031)
entries.notes: The same six action pins in the nine workflows upstream changed, plus actions/setup-dotnet in rewrite-validation.yml, which only the rewrite has and which pinned the old commit.

entries.subject: feat(watchlist): two-way removal sync between Jellyfin and Seerr (#1032)
entries.notes: Route POST jellyseerr/watchlist in JeSeerrController (Users partial) beside the GET, with the same [Authorize] and proxy checks; planner and Seerr watchlist reader in Features/Seerr/Services; the task in Features/Seerr/Tasks under the …ScheduledTasks namespace; registered in SeerrServiceRegistration. Differences from upstream: cancellation reaches every Seerr call of the removal task and is not logged as an error; the rule that hides the two re-add rows runs inside the admin page’s dependency pass; the admin description of the requested-media switch and the docs use the new names and say what the code does (two found bugs filed upstream-side). Contract additions (1 route, 1 action, 1 registration) are in the separate contract commit; tests/fixtures/admin-config-baseline.json gains the new control and its default, as docs/rewrite/admin-config.md prescribes for a schema change.

entries.subject: ci: skip browser tests on pull requests that do not touch web files
entries.notes: The same browser-changes job and condition. The path filter also counts client/, css/ and scripts/client*, where this tree’s web files are built from; upstream’s filter names only the built folders.

entries.subject: fix(spoiler-guard): strip Home Screen Sections rows (#1033)
entries.notes: The same route-table row in Shared/SpoilerGuard/SpoilerFieldStripFilter.cs, upstream’s test, docs sentence and coverage-matrix note. Checked against the real Home Screen Sections 3.0.4.0 plugin on the lab, not only by action name.

entries.subject: fix(recommendations): don't open category tiles after dragging a row (#1030)
entries.notes: The same 8px mouse-drag guard on the studio, network and genre tile rows (client/src/features/seerr/recommendations/recommendations-render.ts), with upstream’s three tests. Added a test that media rows are not guarded, since the rewrite builds all rows from one shell.

entries.subject: fix(audio-language): show audio languages on movie page
entries.notes: The same fallback in client/src/features/details-providers/media-info.ts: a selected version whose /tag-data source entry carries no streams reads the top-level streams. Upstream’s test, plus one that a selected version never borrows another version’s streams.

entries.subject: ci: Fix/code scanning alerts (#1036)
entries.notes: The three code-scanning fixes in the rewrite’s files: the Custom Tabs snippet escaper also escapes quotes (admin/config/sections/pages.ts), review HTML is stripped until no tag is left (details-providers/review-domain.ts), and pause-screen image URLs encode ids and the image tag (player/pausescreen.ts). Upstream added no tests; three are added here and fail before the change. The CI part (CodeQL query filters, hash-pinned docs requirements, licence allow-list) applies as is. No lab comparison: none of the three changes what a user sees with ordinary data.

entries.subject: ci(regression): run the browser suite as one parallel job per Playwright project
entries.notes: The same job matrix (one job per Playwright project, each installing only its browser) and `tests/run.py --project`. The rewrite’s runner keeps its jf12-only `--target`; a tooling test for the new option is added.

entries.subject: docs(readme): add test badges and icons, recolor badge row
entries.notes: The same badge changes. The three test-count badges carry this tree’s counts (699 browser, 3.3k backend, 3.9k frontend) instead of upstream’s, and the 10.11 download badge is not here because the rewrite’s README has none.

entries.subject: feat(leaving-soon): show the Maintainerr key like the TMDB key, add a Maintainerr card and wider URL fields
entries.notes: The C# hunks apply at the rewrite’s paths (Shared/MediaTags/PluginConfigurationPatch.cs and MediaTagsPortable.cs, Features/Platform/Services/CdnAssetService.cs) and the stylesheet as is (js/enhanced/admintags/admin-tags.css is hand-written here too). Re-implemented in TypeScript: the `wide` and `mask` field options (features/media-tags/admin/types.ts and fields.ts), the five field declarations (sections/awards.ts, badges.ts, language.ts), and the Maintainerr card (admin/config/sections/about.ts, with its placeholder in client/html/admin-config/configPage.html). Differences from upstream: docs/enhanced/tags.md carries the same paragraph as the two advanced pages and upstream left it describing a write-only password field, so it is corrected here as well (found bug filed); three tests are added for what upstream left untested (the wide boxes and the stylesheet rules, the Services card, the logo in the CDN prefetch list); tests/fixtures/admin-config-baseline.json gains the `svc-maintainerr` section, as docs/rewrite/admin-config.md prescribes for a schema change. The card has no setting of its own, so the What’s New index is unchanged. No route, authorization or registration changes.
